title: Depth as back-propagation steps: Ns x [FIR + nonlinear phase with memory], layer-wise initialization
git_commit: recorded per run in results/runs/*.json (field git_commit)
model: phys_models.PhysDBP: Ns steps, each a symmetric complex FIR of length L (unit-impulse init) followed by the nonlinear phase with R symmetric coefficients (alpha = 0 init); every step is the identity at start; inside the window of 31 symbols with zero padding; output = centre symbol of the last step
grid_note: R kept at {3, 7} as planned; the plan allows replacing R by the best E016 value after E015 - not done, so the grid does not depend on results that do not exist yet
modes_note: layerwise (paper): train step 1, then add step k (identity) and train it with steps 1..k-1 frozen, k = 2..Ns, steps_per_layer each, fresh Adam per phase; then joint fine-tuning of all steps for finetune_steps at lr / finetune_lr_divisor. joint_from_scratch: all steps trainable from the start for the same total Ns*steps_per_layer + finetune_steps
lr_note: the plan does not fix the lr for E018: Adam constant 1e-3 per phase, fine-tuning 1e-3 / 3
macs: Ns * macs_phys(R, L, sym = True); e.g. Ns = 8, L = 31, R = 7: 8 * 74 = 592

metrics.seed_spread: range; the larger of the two compared groups

rule_draft.status: DRAFT: to be confirmed by the user before the first run; must not change after results are seen
rule_draft.depth_helps: among layerwise configurations with Ns in {4, 8} and multiplies <= 16032 (complex_both), the one with the best mean validation reduction beats Ns = 1 with the same L, R and mode on test by >= 1 p.p. and by more than the seed spread
rule_draft.layerwise_needed: among layerwise configurations with Ns > 1, the one with the best mean validation reduction beats joint_from_scratch with the same Ns, L, R on test by >= 1 p.p. and by more than the seed spread
